Basic chat completion against real Google Gemini API

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["GEMINI_API_KEY"])
    request = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"max_tokens\":10,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello in exactly one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite\"}")
    result = await client.chat(request)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
